message: マジカルうぃっちナナカちゃん

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, where did that girl who was just here go?」

name: Synn
message: 「If we're talking about where Nanaka would go, there's only one place.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, it's the classroom, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「There she is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, look, check this out! Isn't it super cute!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yahoo, Synn-kun. Are Student Council activities already over~?」

name: Synn
message: 「No. That's why I came to drag her back, but...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「This year's Student Council is amazing~ Are you planning a costume party or something~?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's nothing like that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin! Take a picture with my phone too!」
Ah, she's making such a big deal out of it without even knowing she's naked.
Nanaka transformed and wound up naked just like Ria-senpai, didn't she...

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, ahhh~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, what's wrong with you!」
Getting flustered over my childhood friend--
Bad, bad thoughts!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at how popular I am!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's great for you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It really is cute~ I almost didn't recognize you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh stop, don't flatter me so much!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Basically, you're saying she's not much to look at usually, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I didn't go that far~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Subtly dissing your own friend... Heh heh heh... As expected of Lord Synn's classmate.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's one evil panda~」

name: Synn
message: 「And somehow that's my fault!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez, all of you! You're making me blush!」
She didn't listen to a single word.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, don't go interrupting everyone.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Naw, it's totally fine~ In fact, if the president isn't here--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmm? Ain't Lord Synn the president?」

name: Synn
message: 「This isn't the Student Council, it's the Cake Appreciation Club.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Sweets Club!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan is our club president~」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you guys even doin'?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「We're about to have a tasting session~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Satchin, did you buy them?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「They actually had brand new items~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oooh, nice!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~ I'll take them out now~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wow, real cakes!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So? Don't these cakes look delicious~?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Soba. Do I really gotta point out the elephant in the room?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Satchin... don't tell me you bought these at a convenience store?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「*Gasp*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you before, the most important thing about sweets is whether there's heart poured into them, didn't I?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Umm, I think there's heart poured into these cakes too~ Like from the factory workers and--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Naive! Far too naive! Leave the sweetness for the treats!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think such a thing toward the works of art that top-class patissiers painstakingly create for their customers...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What an atrocity! Utter blasphemy! Now, apologize to the patisseries!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Eek, I'm sorry! I'm sorry!」

name: Paqy
message: 「An unyielding passion for what you love. As expected of the club president.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Student Council President could learn a thing or two from you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, if you don't want this cake, can I eat it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Didn't hear a word.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about?! How disrespectful to the guy at the factory!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So you *are* gonna eat it...\s02」
